faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.how_order_q: How do I place an order?
faq.how_order_a: Add dishes to the cart, tap “Place order”, choose a break or “As soon as possible” and pay.
faq.when_q: When can I pick it up?
faq.when_a: At the break you chose. When the kitchen marks the order ready, you’ll get a notification and the QR button in the centre will start to glow.
faq.pickup_q: How do I pick up the order?
faq.pickup_a: Tap the QR button in the centre of the bottom bar and show the code at the counter. The order number is on the screen too.
faq.late_q: What if I don’t make it in time?
faq.late_a: A ready order waits for 30 minutes. After that it’s closed as “not picked up”.
faq.cancel_a: Yes, until the kitchen starts cooking: open the order and tap “Cancel order”. The money will be refunded.
faq.payment_a: In this version, Apple Pay and Google Pay payments are simulated: no money is charged.
faq.cant_order_q: Why can’t I place an order?
faq.cant_order_a: The kitchen may have paused taking orders; a banner on the home screen will say so. You can still browse the menu and order a bit later.
faq.name_q: How do I change my name?
faq.name_a: More → My profile. The phone number can’t be changed: it’s your login.
faq.delete_q: How do I delete my account?
faq.delete_a: More → My profile → Settings → “Delete account”. Pick up or cancel your active orders first.
